profiles.name: smoke_strand
profiles.provenance: packed 4-channel sheet for trail_deform.fs mode 2, SMOKE style. R and G are each ONE COMPLETE SMOKE WISP (head/tail taper painted in, a few curls rolling through), matching the reference sheet's 拖尾紋理 channels — NOT a tileable filament material. It is STRETCHED once over the whole trail; tiling it produces a rope of identical segments with no silhouette. B = flow distortion, A = dissolve, both seamless because those two are panned. Built by scripts/gen_smoke_strand_texture.py.

body.channels: STRAND | R:pattern1/STRETCH | G:pattern2/STRETCH | B:distort/TILE | A:dissolve/TILE — R/G are one complete wisp each with head and tail taper painted in (SHAPE, maps once); B/A are panned every frame so they must be seamless

profiles.name: fire_tongue
profiles.provenance: Taichi direction-bearing rising combustion column. +Z is baked as up for one torch/ground/jet flame; it has continuous buoyancy, time-varying fuel and temporal curl so its late frames keep changing instead of settling into one static gas shape. Built by: ti_sim.py fire_tongue --res 96 --frames 64 --domain 1.4 | render.py --cell 256 --supersample 2 --zoom auto --light 1.0 --density-scale 2.2 --flame-extinction 0.10 --flame-scale 3.0 --emission-gamma 0.82 | pack.py --grid 8 --alpha-from-luma 0 --shape column --split.

Built by: ti_sim.py fire_puff --res 112 --frames 64 | render.py --density-scale 7 --zoom auto | pack.py --split --shape puff.

profiles.name: fire_volume_sheet
profiles.provenance: Ray-marched Taichi directionless combustion parcel kept PACKED. fire_volume_puff uses one connected ignition source, fine isotropic eddies and a hotter, less soot-dominant life cycle without baking lift, a flame-tongue silhouette or visibly separate sub-puffs; the emitter/force field owns that shape. Its split sibling is VFX_SURFACE_FIRE_PUFF: splitting collapses R to a white mask and throws the per-texel temperature field away, so a sprite off that sheet can only ever be one flat hue. Built by: ti_sim.py fire_volume_puff --res 96 --frames 64 | render.py --cell 256 --supersample 2 --zoom auto --light 1.0 --density-scale 6 --flame-extinction 1.5 --flame-scale 4.5 | pack.py --grid 8 --alpha-from-luma 0 --shape puff (NO --split).

body.channels: VOLUME | R:emission/CLAMP | G:density/CLAMP | B:shadow/CLAMP | A:opacity/CLAMP — colourless by design: R is a temperature field that indexes the ramp LUT, so the same sheet serves fire, purple magic fire and blue ghost-flame. B/G is the light fraction that survived to each texel.

profiles.name: volume_noise
profiles.provenance: Displacement noise for core/deform/mesh_deform.h — four decorrelated scalar fields, one per channel, so a single bilinear fetch feeds one deform layer. Loaded by core/trails/trail_system.c as an Image (CPU), not as a Texture: the deform runs at mesh-build time. Was outside the registry entirely until 03/08/2026. Built by scripts/gen_volume_trail_textures.py.

body.channels: NOISE | R:field/TILE | G:field/TILE | B:field/TILE | A:field/TILE — pure DATA, never drawn. Four independent fields; core/deform reads R and G as its two octaves. Seamless on both axes: the section is closed, so a non-periodic field creases the whole length of the body.

profiles.name: shock_ring_smoke
profiles.provenance: Simulated, not authored: scripts/gen_shock_ring_smoke.py advects clustered particles through a divergence-free curl-noise field and splats their streaklines. An fbm is statistically homogeneous, so a ring eroded from one reads as a necklace of identical beads no matter how it is tuned; advection gives long sweeping strokes next to fine detail next to nothing, because neighbouring regions have different histories. Periodic in x and zero on its top and bottom rows, so the consumer tiles it around the ring instead of dodging blank ends. Deterministic from --seed; regenerate rather than hand-edit.

body.channels: OPAQUE | R:color/TILE | G:color/TILE | B:color/TILE | A:opacity/TILE — thin swirling smoke filaments. RGB stays neutral so VFX_Material supplies element colour; A is the true density/coverage sampled by shock_ring.fs. Seamless in x so it wraps the ring, and zero at top and bottom so panning runs the smoke off the band.
